snippet.title: Touhou Shinmadan ~ The Ancient Square OST (Java Phone Fangame)
snippet.description:
This is the entire OST for the fangame "Touhou: Shinmadan". The composer of this game was DHI, who you might know as the composer of "Touhou: Fanmade Virtual Autography". These aren't just MIDI ports: they're full-on arrangements of Touhou songs, and they're pretty great! I hope you enjoy listening! (Note: this is being played through a Java Emulator running on Windows 11: the songs may not sound the same as they did on original hardware). 

Check out my overview video on this game and other Touhou Java Phone Games here: https://youtu.be/XbJKpIwfU04?si=7xa1sMY7rCGOK6Bj
Touhou Shinmadan Wiki Link: https://keitaiwiki.miraheze.org/wiki/Touhou_Shinmadan
DHI's Twitter: https://x.com/kraihd
